description: Full details of one listing from list_services (id): type, municipality and district, position, website, prices with units (e.g. per person per night), capacity (beds, extra beds, rooms), minimum stay, check-in and check-out, season and open months, room amenities and amenities for anglers, payment methods, spoken languages, owner-declared distance to the water, the nearest fishing waters measured to the shoreline or the water line (with typical fish), photos and a short summary in Slovak. Texts are supplied by the business owner; phone and e-mail are only on the listing page, where the enquiry form sends a message directly to the owner.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

name: get_service
